about_the_game:
🌀 Infinite Backrooms

Enter an endless maze of fluorescent corridors, abandoned offices, and liminal spaces. The environment shifts between familiar and uncanny, keeping you guessing what lies beyond each corner. Procedural layouts and layered atmosphere ensure no two journeys feel the same.

🤝 Cooperative Survival & Exploration

Play solo or team up with friends in online co-op. Communicate to avoid getting lost, share clues, and solve environmental puzzles together. Some paths require teamwork to progress, making cooperation the key to survival.

🎧 Features & Atmosphere

  • Dynamic levels with eerie, dreamlike design

  • Puzzles that blend exploration with tension

  • Online co-op with seamless drop-in/out

  • Ambient soundscapes and subtle horror elements

  • A balance of mystery, survival, and discovery

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 20.04 LTS or equivalent
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-3470 / AMD FX-8350
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 660 2GB / AMD HD 7870 2GB (with Vulkan support)
  • Storage: 10 GB available space

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 10.15 (Catalina) or later
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 Quad-Core or Apple Silicon (via Rosetta 2)
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel Core i5 Quad-Core or Apple Silicon (via Rosetta 2)

name: BACKROOMS

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4430
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 960 2GB
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Latest drivers for AMD and NVIDIA GPUs are required. If on AMD, you must be on the latest OPTIONAL drivers.
